title: Digital Expanse
intro: I’m ______, a product designer based in ______. What follows is a running account of the things I make, written the way I would tell it to you. There is not much here yet. The board below shows what state each thing is in; the plates show what it looks like; the entries say what it is. Nothing is removed. Things come to rest, they don’t disappear.

works.title: Copilot custom models
works.prose: Helping enterprise admins choose training data and configure a custom model without becoming training experts. I led design from limited-beta refinements to explorations for a more guided setup. A working account of the whole flow and the smaller decisions within it.
works.caption: 2024, custom model configuration. Beta design, cropped.

works.title: Digital Expanse
works.prose: This site, an index of works, always in progress. It began as a table on ruled paper, then a chart, then a manuscript. Now it is a manuscript with plates: the pictures do the first telling and the text does the second.
works.caption: 2026 Sept, this index, v1
